translation:
I left interviewing the computer society to
Nagato while the rest of us met up with Haruhi.
Ah—where'd Yuki go?

So I explained that she went to ask the
computer society questions.
[#DP]

Upon hearing this, Haruhi assumed a
ponderous expression and sank into silence.

Don't tell me—she suspects that we might be
hiding something from her?

I needed some kind of excuse to change the
topic… But before I could think of one—

I don't think there's any point in all of us
searching in one group.

Said our lord brigade chief, as if her
conclusion came after extensive consideration.
…Why do you say that all of a sudden?

When I heard that Yuki left to interrogate
the club I was suddenly inspired!

I don't know what caused her inspiration, but
it seemed like just a standard realization.

From here we should all split up and search on
our own!
Wait wait—what about my sister?
I'll take your little sister with me.

I'm glad someone's looking after her, but I'm
not sure I can feel at ease when it's you.

Miss Suzumiya, how should we go about
carrying out our search?

How about we decide a meetup time, split into
groups, and look around?
Eehh—we're going to all be separated…?

Exactly. Even Yuki went to investigate on her
own.
I-I get what you mean buuut…
Mikuru—don't tell me you're scared?
N-no…

You don't have to push yourself or anything,
but it's not going to be scary, okay?
Ehh, o-okayyy…

Asahina was like a single daisy in a strong
wind.
So small and trembling and frightened…

Oh right—I managed to overhear something
interesting.
What did you overhear, I wonder?

A certain somebody said they were walking
down a hallway with no sign of anyone else—

Behind them, they could hear another set of
footsteps following along.
Eek!

Thinking it was strange, they looked back
and got the feeling that someone was there…
But there was nobody there at all.
[#SK0W]-waaah…

With that unnecessarily vivid narration,
Asahina started turning pale.
Oi—Haruhi!
What?! I'm just getting to the good part!

They continued down the hall thinking it was
all in their head, but again the footsteps…

[#SK0Wwawawa]—
[#SK0Th]-that can really happen?
Indeed, but that's not all—

They kept looking over their shoulder in
discomfort, until they looked back and…
[#SK0Th]-they looked back and…?

From a place where nobody should have
been…[#W30]
Suddenly, a human face!
[#SK0Hyyyaaaaa]!

Asahina just might faint from the shock of
that ghost story.
And in addition to that—

Hey—that's enough of that. Don't scare
Asahina any further.

She was about five seconds away from
bursting into tears because of your story.

And if something like that actually happened,
I wouldn't be able to bear it!

Geez—it was just getting exciting. Don't ruin
it!

But, well—we are burning daylight, so I'll
leave it there.

Is that what you have to say after stirring
up so much fear? What a person.

Aaaahhhh, i-it's over, right? Thank
goodness.

Now that the story is over, Asahina finally
seems to be at ease.

So like I was saying originally—we're going to
split up and search around!
Eeeeeh—! P-please no…
Understood.
Hey—you're kidding right?!

Not only scaring people but also sending them
out alone—

How cruel can you be… not that I wasn't
already aware of that though.

U-um… Is it okay if I at least go together with
Kyon?

Why of course, Miss Asahina—I'd love to go
with you.

No. Rejected. Absolutely not. That would be
terribly inefficient.

C'mon, c'mon—get moving already! You got
that, Mikuru?!
Aaaah—please no…
Asahina resisted until the very end—

But she was no match for Haruhi's
persistence…

So we all went off in different directions by
ourselves.
—Is what should've happened at least.
[#P06Hold] on!
Mm? H-hey—what are you doing?!

Just as I started to walk, Haruhi suddenly
pulled me out of view.

[#P06I] believe we'll now be taking part in a special
operation.

Before I knew it Koizumi appeared. What
happened to Asahina?

[#P06We]'re gonna make Mikuru the protagonist of a
horror movie.
[#P06What]? What's that supposed to mean?

[#P06We]'re gonna follow behind her stealthily and
film her.

[#P06We] should be able to get some really nice
shots.

Talk about poor taste—and as for why we're
doing this, I have no idea.
[#P06Quit] your grumbling. Look—follow her!
[#P06Understood].
[#P06Oi]—wait up!

There was no way I could just let Haruhi do as
she pleased.

But without any choice in the matter, I
decided to accompany them.

By the way, why are we recording such a
thing all of a sudden?

It was probably pointless to ask for a solid
reason—but just in case, I did anyway.

What do you mean "why?” It's for the SOS
Brigade activity record, obviously!

It just struck me earlier—beautiful girls are
an absolute must for horror.

We're just following that tried-and-true
tradition!

It's just that I thought we should try looking
for some new appeal in Mikuru.

Even without looking for it, Asahina's appeal
is more than satisfactory.

Actually—where did you even get that video
camera from in the first place?

No matter how you look at it—you have some
terrible hobbies.
You don't get it, do you.

It's important to look at things from an
outside-the-box perspective isn't it?

What nerve to say such a thing while
recording a terrified-looking Asahina.

As expected—Miss Suzumiya's way of thinking
differs from the average person.

Oi Koizumi. Don't butter Haruhi up too
much—she'll get carried away, you know.

Just like that, with us dubious stalkers
following unbeknownst to her…

Aaaaah… I-it's just my imagination, right…?
That slight sound of footsteps…

If three amateurs are tailing you, it's only
natural to hear footsteps.
T-there's no one there… Right?

She occasionally gave a timid look back over
her shoulder, then continued on again.

Uuh—I just remembered that story from
earlier… What should I do…

[#P06Yes]—nice facial expression, Mikuru! Good.
That's right on the mark!

Every time Asahina gets startled, you're
there gleefully recording it. Shameless.

But even I must admit—the sight of a
beautiful girl looking scared isn't bad at all.

…Having thought something like that, I'm
going to need some self-reflection.

No, hold on—I feel really bad for Asahina
right now.
I have to do something about it…
Asahin—[#W60]
[#SK0Hyyyaaaaa]?! A v-voice?!
Ah—
I terrified her. Did that backfire?
Eeek!

She was in such a panic that she seemingly
stepped on something and fell over.
Oouch… I-it hurts…

[#P06Nice] going, Mikuru! You're pulling off the
perfect clumsy girl!

Ah, I was trying to reassure her, but I
accidentally did something awful…

Incidentally—I wonder what could Asahina
have stepped on?

Hm? This is what she stepped on? I wonder
whose [#P05handkerchief][#P00] this is?
I think I'll hold on to this for the time being.
[#P06Koizumi]—I feel way too bad for Asahina.
[#P06You] should also tell Haruhi to call this off.
[#P06That]'s quite troubling I'm afraid…

[#P06While] I do feel bad for Miss Asahina, I don't
believe it's wise to interrupt now.
[#P06Why] not?
[#P06If] we put an end to Miss Suzumiya's fun now…
[#P06She] may not yet be entirely satisfied.

[#P06And] you're gonna say it'll cause closed space
or whatever to form.
[#P06Yes]—precisely.

[#P06Due] apologies to Miss Asahina, but for now
let's just fondly watch over her.

If it were me, I'd only get chills from being
fondly watched by this guy.
Hey, what are you guys doing over there?!
Don't dawdle or you'll lose sight of Mikuru!

Just because I can't help her doesn't mean I
won't watch out for her.

All I can do is stop Haruhi from getting
further out of control, huh…
C'mon—we need to get closer.
If we get too close she may notice us.

But recording zoomed in makes the camera
shake terrible.
Like he said, we shouldn't get too close.
Hyah… I-is someone there…?
Everybody hide!
W-w-who's there?

I told you so. Asahina seems to have noticed
us.

[#SK0Ehhh]… There's no one there… [#W30I] hate this—I'm
scared—
Asahina was paralyzed in utter terror.

I might have to put an end to Haruhi's
ill-natured playtime soon.
Asahina…
[$4][#SK0Noooooooooooo]!! A f-face!!
Errh—!
It hurts… Asahina's hands went for my face…
Aah! Kyon!

Nice going Mikuru! I got the ultimate facial
expression on video!
Eeeh… You were recording me?
You were so cute, Mikuru!
Uuhhh… that's so meeaan…
Haruhi looks ecstatic…

I truly feel awful about everything Asahina's
been put through.
For the record—I'm pretty miserable as well.
We'll have to thoroughly edit this video later!
Haha—I'm looking forward to it.

I'm certain it'll be a wonderful video once it's
completed.

Just what are you looking so happy about,
Koizumi?

Let's see if you can keep up that smile after
stepping in my shoes for a single minute.
U-um, Kyon… Are you okay?
Yep. I'm completely fine.

It was just like the scary story—I suddenly
saw a face, so I was really startled.
…Oh.

Tell me I'm wrong, but does that mean this was
the actualization of Haruhi's ghost story?
I'm really sorry…
Not at all—it was all Haruhi's fault.

What are you talking about? I'm heading back
to the clubroom.

While seeing Haruhi off as she joyously left,
camera in hand…

…I was overcome by an unbelievably
unpleasant feeling.

Koizumi, has she ever told you ghost stories
before?

Of course, I only mean those specifically
related to North High.

I'm afraid not. Only ordinary ghost stories
that could happen anywhere.

So that means she told it just to scare
Asahina…?
I don't think that's likely.

We can say Haruhi's story was actualized,
but we can also say it was a coincidence.

Either way—I've already thought about it
more than I'd like.

We should begin our preparations now,
wouldn't you say?
Preparations?

I'm talking about arranging a truth that
would satisfy Miss Suzumiya.

Some kind of set-up that would give her a
false idea of what caused the phenomenon…?

Precisely. Although I'm not sure specifically
what the best way to do that would be.

Can't you use your powers to show her class
1-10 for real?

Regrettably, my powers are simply not
capable of such things.
You certainly sound sure of yourself.

However, if we use a trick—showing her class
1-10 should certainly be possible.
A trick?

Something like replacing a class number
plate?

Well, not that I think such a classic method
would be able to fool Haruhi…
That's a fantastic idea.
…Are you serious?
I'm very serious of course.
I think so too.
Even you, Asahina…?

Do you usually look at the plate when you go
to your classroom?

Not really—it's intuition or muscle memory, I
guess?

So, you don't pay any notice to the class
plate, right?

If the plates were offset to the next class,
you would go in without noticing, right?

Let's see… The class at the far end is class
six, so if we put class seven's plate instead…

I see—so opposite class nine would be
become an illusion of class ten.
Yes. That's why your idea is so good.

Even as the original proposer of the idea, I
didn't think it through this far.
But, well—I guess it all worked out in the end.
Well then, let's get straight to preparing it.
…Sure.

I doubt she'd actually fall for such a thing,
but I suppose it's worth giving a shot.

Unfortunately, I'm not able to reach the
plate…

You can just get a chair or a desk from the
classroom, right?
It appears to be locked.
Damn, I don't know what to do then…

I'll look for something we can use as a step
up.

He's actually gone off to look, even though
I'm not sure we have time for that.
Asahina, I have a suggestion.
Yes—what is it?

How about you use me as a platform and take
the plates off?
Ehh—well, t-that's…

We don't have much time here, so we can't wait
for Koizumi to return.
I-I see…

The tender-hearted Asahina is hesitant
about using me as stepladder…
…But there's no way around it.

I don't want to step on or be stepped on by
Koizumi, but if it's Asahina—no problem.
Alright. Please make it quick.
I-I understand…

Asahina stepped on my back slowly and
nervously—as expected of our angel.
She's light enough you'd think she grew wings.
How is it? Can you reach?

I should be able to reach with just a little bit
more.
Okay, then I'm gonna try stretching a bit.
Hyaa—y-you're wobbling.
I'm sorry but I can't really go much slower…
I think… my fingertips can just about reach.
Keep at it—Asahina.

W-whoa whoa, Kyon, if you move so suddenly
my balance will—a-aahhhh—!
Are you alright, Asahina?
Hyaa—!
Ugh!

Asahina's foot slipped when her balance
broke, and she fell on my back.
I wanted to call her a fallen angel…
…but then the plate fell on my head.
Ahh—ouch…

Kyon, I'm so sorry! Does it hurt? Are you
okay?
N-no no, I'm fine of course.

Ahhh, the plate left a mark on your head! It's
not swelling, is it?

With but the caress of your hand, even such
a wound would heal instantly.

We removed the plate, but it'll be hard to
replace it…
What should we do? We don't have much time…

We don't have much time, and our options are
limited. So what should we do?

Well… should we try it again? Just one more
time?

I think we should wait for Koizumi to return
with something to stand on.
If I fall down again, you'll be crushed flat.

That part is fine—it's the direct hit from the
plate I want to avoid.
Ah! There should be a band-aid in my pocket…
Here, Kyon.
Th-thank you very much…

I don't know if this [#P05band]-aid[#P01] will help with my
head, but…

If it's filled with Asahina's feelings of
thoughtfulness, I'm very grateful.

There's no time and I don't want to wait for
Koizumi—let's give up.
I see… I'm sorry I couldn't help…

Not at all! It's because of you that we were
able to get the plate down.

Although I don't know what this [#P05class] 6 plate[#P01]
will be useful for if anything…

But I should be grateful Asahina worked so
hard to get me this plate.

I might be able to find some use for it, so I'll
take it with me.

Let's head back to the clubroom while keeping
an eye out for Koizumi.
Okay.
Ah—I can feel my head throbbing.
Call out to Asahina
Ask Koizumi to put a stop to this
Try again
Give up
